rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically putting something into liquid.

example.english: I immerse the tea bag in hot water.
example.traditional: 我將茶包浸喺熱水入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 caa4 baau1 zam3 hai2 jit6 seoi2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this for actively devoting yourself deeply to a subject, activity, or study.

example.english: I immerse myself in researching this topic so deeply that I even forget to eat.
example.traditional: 我全心投入研究呢個課題，連食飯都唔記得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cyun4 sam1 tau4 jap6 jin4 gau3 ne1 go3 fo3 tai4 lin4 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1
